62: /// Parses the rest of a [PEP 723](https://peps.python.org/pep-0723/)

64: /// the script comment is invalid.

66: /// Returns `true` if it is a valid script comment.
67: fn skip_script_comments<I>(
68:     script_start: TextRange,
69:     comments: &mut std::iter::Peekable<I>,
70:     locator: &Locator,
71: ) -> bool
72: where
73:     I: Iterator<Item = TextRange>,
74: {
75:     let line_end = locator.full_line_end(script_start.end());
76:     let rest = locator.after(line_end);
77:     let mut end_offset = None;
78:     let mut lines = UniversalNewlineIterator::with_offset(rest, line_end);
79: 
80:     while let Some(line) = lines.next() {
81:         let Some(content) = script_line_content(&line) else {
82:             break;
83:         };
84: 
85:         if content == "///" {
86:             // > Precedence for an ending line # /// is given when the next line is not a valid
87:             // > embedded content line as described above.
88:             // > For example, the following is a single fully valid block:
89:             // > ```python
90:             // > # /// some-toml
91:             // > # embedded-csharp = """
92:             // > # /// <summary>
93:             // > # /// text
94:             // > # ///
95:             // > # /// </summary>
96:             // > # public class MyClass { }
97:             // > # """
98:             // > # ///
99:             // ````
100:             if lines.next().is_some_and(|line| is_valid_script_line(&line)) {
101:                 continue;
102:             }
103:             end_offset = Some(line.full_end());
104:             break;
105:         }
106:     }

108:     // > Unclosed blocks MUST be ignored.
109:     let Some(end_offset) = end_offset else {
110:         return false;
111:     };

113:     // Skip over all script-comments.
114:     while let Some(comment) = comments.peek() {
115:         if comment.start() >= end_offset {

117:         }
118: 
119:         comments.next();
